[[Travel Scroll to the Wizard Tower]] |dont_autofill_npcs = Yes |id = hub }} The '''Hub Island''' is the first island that the player can travel to upon leaving their [[Private Island]]. It is a centralised island that connects to a multitude of other islands: the {{Zone|Village}} can be found at the center, which branches off into specialised zones, each revolving around different [[Skills]]. == Locations == The '''Hub Island''' consists of many sub-locations, each with their own purpose.
